Implementation Plan

Clarification mapping: no Q<ID> items were asked; `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` indicates planning can proceed without additional clarification.

Implementation plan

1. Files likely to change
- `prompts/serena-efficiency-block.txt` (new canonical source with two variants).
- `prompts/mode-implement.txt`
- `prompts/mode-plan.txt`
- `prompts/mode-orchestrate.txt`
- `prompts/mode-clarify.txt`
- `prompts/mode-judge.txt`
- `prompts/mode-clarify-respond.txt`
- `prompts/mode-validate-generate.txt`
- `prompts/mode-validate-diagnose.txt`
- `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt`
- Prompt assembly consumers that currently `cat` mode files directly (required to avoid unresolved include markers):
  - `.github/workflows/orchestrate.yml`
  - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml`
  - `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
  - `.github/workflows/validate.yml`
  - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`
  - `scripts/validate_process.sh`
  - `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
- Optional guardrail update: `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` (assert canonical fragment exists and renders cleanly).

2. Functions/modules to implement
- Add a small prompt-render helper module (shell helper or script) that:
  - Extracts `read-only` or `read-write` block from `prompts/serena-efficiency-block.txt`.
  - Replaces mode-file placeholder token(s) before prompt submission.
  - Fails fast if placeholders remain unresolved.
- Migrate each mode prompt to consume canonical Serena content via placeholder token, keeping mode-specific non-Serena instructions unchanged.
- Wire all runtime prompt builders (workflow/script call sites above) to use rendered prompt content instead of raw `cat` of mode files.

3. Data structures affected
- New canonical fragment structure with explicit section delimiters for:
  - `READ_ONLY`
  - `READ_WRITE`
- Mode prompt files gain a stable placeholder token contract (one token per variant).
- Variant mapping by mode:
  - Read-only: `clarify`, `plan`, `orchestrate`, `judge`, `clarify-respond`, `validate-diagnose`
  - Read-write: `implement`, `validate-generate`, `judge-review-blocked`

4. API/interface changes
- No external API, DB, or user-facing contract changes.
- Internal prompt assembly contract changes:
  - Mode files are no longer self-contained for Serena block text; renderer becomes required at assembly points.
  - Workflows that fetch prompt assets must also fetch the canonical fragment (and helper if added as separate script).

5. Potential risks and edge cases
- Unresolved include/placeholder shipped to model prompt (hard failure against issue constraint).
- Wrong variant assignment for write-capable phases (`validate-generate`, `judge-review-blocked`).
- Semantic drift if canonical text rewrites behavior instead of preserving current intent.
- Consumer repo compatibility when running older refs that do not yet include the new canonical file/helper.
- Accidental modification of strict output-contract sections while editing prompt files.

6. Testing considerations
- Add/extend checks to render each mode prompt and assert:
  - No unresolved placeholder tokens remain.
  - Exactly one Serena block is injected.
- Add repository grep assertions:
  - Canonical Serena guidance appears only in `prompts/serena-efficiency-block.txt`.
  - Mode files no longer contain independent duplicated Serena paragraphs.
- Run syntax checks on modified shell/workflow files (`bash -n`, workflow validation already in CI).
- Smoke-test prompt assembly paths used by:
  - validate generate/diagnose
  - orchestrate
  - clarify-respond
  - judge
  - review-blocked judge

Conflict detected with issue/codebase
- The issue scope lists only prompt files, but current runtime consumers directly `cat` mode files. To satisfy “no unresolved include syntax” while deduplicating, prompt assembly call sites must also be updated in scripts/workflows; prompt-only edits are insufficient.
- `mode-clarify.txt`, `mode-plan.txt`, and `mode-implement.txt` are currently not the primary runtime source for those phases (inline workflow prompts are used there), so this issue can eliminate prompt-file duplication first but will not fully eliminate workflow-inline duplication in the same change.
